
?>
<script>
    function  liveReload(){
        console.log('Reloading...');
        fetch('/.vscode/checker.php?file=FILENAME')
            .then(response => response.text())
            .then(data => {
                if (data.trim() === 'reload') {
                    location.reload();
                }
            })
            .catch(error => console.error('Live reload error:', error));
    }
    setInterval(liveReload, 2000); // Check for changes every 2 seconds
</script>
